import { reactive, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { useDnDMonitor, type SortableDropEvent } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Column from './Column.vue';
import ConfirmDialog from './ConfirmDialog.vue';
import type { Answer, Task } from './types';

const columns = reactive([
  {
    id: 'todo',
    title: 'To do',
    color: '#a1a1aa',
    tasks: [
      { id: 'changelog', title: 'Write the changelog' },
      { id: 'tag', title: 'Tag the release' },
      { id: 'announce', title: 'Announce it' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'done',
    title: 'Done',
    color: '#42b883',
    confirm: true,
    tasks: [{ id: 'tests', title: 'Fix the flaky tests' }],
  },
]);

// The open question: the card it is about, and how to answer the waiting `onBeforeDrop`.
const question = shallowRef<{ title: string; resolve: (answer: Answer) => void } | null>(null);
const resumed = shallowRef(false);

/** Opens the dialog. The drop waits for the answer, the overlay where it was let go. */
const ask = (event: SortableDropEvent<Task>) =>
  new Promise<Answer>((resolve) => {
    resumed.value = false;
    question.value = { title: event.items[0]!.title, resolve };
  });

const answer = (value: Answer) => {
  question.value?.resolve(value);
  question.value = null;
};

// After "Keep dragging" the card follows the pointer with no button held: a click drops it.
useDnDMonitor({
  onDragResume() {
    resumed.value = true;
  },
  onDragEnd() {
    resumed.value = false;
  },
  onDragCancel() {
    resumed.value = false;
  },
});
</script>

<template>
  <div class="release">
    <div class="board">
      <Column v-for="column in columns" :key="column.id" :column="column" :ask="ask" />
    </div>
    <p v-if="resumed" class="hint resumed">Still dragging: click to drop, Esc to cancel</p>
    <p v-else class="hint">Cards moving into Done ask first</p>
    <ConfirmDialog v-if="question" :title="question.title" @answer="answer" />

const props = defineProps<{
  column: { id: string; title: string; rule?: 'put' | 'onBeforeDrop'; files: Attachment[] };
}>();

// The same rule, two ways.
// `group.put`: asked while dragging. A refused drag never enters the list.
const group: SortableGroupOptions =
  props.column.rule === 'put'
    ? { name: 'attachments', put: ({ items }) => fits(items as Attachment[]) }
    : { name: 'attachments' };

// What the last release sent back, until the next drag.
const notice = ref('');
useDnDMonitor({ onDragStart: () => (notice.value = '') });

const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
const { items, isOver, isAccepting } = makeSortableList(list, {
  id: props.column.id,
  items: toRef(props.column, 'files'),
  group,
  // `onBeforeDrop`: asked on release. The drag enters the list, then flies back.
  onBeforeDrop: (event) => {
    if (props.column.rule !== 'onBeforeDrop' || fits(event.items)) return 'accept';
    notice.value = `${event.items[0]!.name}: over ${LIMIT} MB, sent back`;
    return 'reject';
  },
});
</script>

<template>
  <section class="column" :class="{ over: isOver && isAccepting, refuses: isOver && !isAccepting }">
    <h3>{{ column.title }}</h3>
    <code v-if="column.rule" class="rule">{{ column.rule === 'put' ? 'group.put' : 'onBeforeDrop' }}</code>
    <ul ref="list" class="files">
      <Card v-for="file in items" :key="file.id" :file="file" />
    </ul>
    <p v-if="column.rule === 'onBeforeDrop'" class="notice" role="status">{{ notice }}</p>
    <p v-else-if="column.rule === 'put'" class="notice refused">{{ isOver && !isAccepting ? `Over ${LIMIT} MB: refused` : '' }}</p>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, toRef, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableList, useDnD } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import PersonRow from './PersonRow.vue';
import { CAPACITY, seatsLeft, type Person } from './server';

const props = defineProps<{ column: { id: string; title: string; seats?: boolean; people: Person[] } }>();

const notice = ref('');
// Seats booked by others, as the server last said.
const others = ref(0);
const why = ref('');
const { selection } = useDnD();
const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
const { items, isOver } = makeSortableList(list, {
  id: props.column.id,
  items: toRef(props.column, 'people'),
  group: 'workshop',
  // Only the server knows how many seats are left. The drop waits for it, the overlay
  // where it was let go, then takes as many people as fit: the others fly back.
  onBeforeDrop: async (event) => {
    if (!props.column.seats || event.sameList) return 'accept';
    notice.value = 'Checking seats…';
    const { free, takenElsewhere } = await seatsLeft(props.column.people.length + others.value);
    others.value += takenElsewhere;
    why.value = takenElsewhere ? 'a seat just went to someone else' : 'the workshop is full';
    if (!free) notice.value = `None booked: ${why.value}`;
    // No keys at all: nothing lands, and `onDrop` isn't called.
    return event.keys.slice(0, free);
  },
  onDrop: (event) => {
    if (!props.column.seats || event.sameList) return;
    // The people sent back stay selected.
    selection.delete(...event.accepted);
    notice.value = event.rejected.length
      ? `${event.accepted.length} booked, ${event.rejected.length} back: ${why.value}`
      : `${event.accepted.length} booked`;
  },
});
</script>

  id: string;

}

export const CAPACITY = 5;

/**
 * The booking server: how many seats are left for the people being added. Others book
 * the workshop too, so the count is only known when asked: sometimes a seat has just gone.
 */
export const seatsLeft = (booked: number): Promise<{ free: number; takenElsewhere: number }> =>
  new Promise((resolve) =>
    setTimeout(() => {
      const takenElsewhere = Math.min(Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : 0, CAPACITY - booked);
      resolve({ free: CAPACITY - booked - takenElsewhere, takenElsewhere });
    }, 700),
  );

import { ref, useTemplateRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { makeDroppable, makeSortableList } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Card from './Card.vue';
import type { Answer, Trace } from './types';

const props = defineProps<{ answer: Answer; trace: Trace }>();

const notes = ref([

  { id: 'call', title: 'Call the plumber' },
  { id: 'book', title: 'Return the book' },
  { id: 'plants', title: 'Water the plants' },
]);

const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
const { items } = makeSortableList(list, {
  id: 'notes',
  items: notes,
  // Asked when the notes are reordered: the list is the target.
  onBeforeDrop: () => {
    props.trace('list', `onBeforeDrop → ${props.answer}`);
    return props.answer;
  },
  // Told when it is the target, and when notes leave it for the trash (`to.index` -1).
  onDrop: (event) => props.trace('list', event.to.index < 0 ? 'onDrop, removed' : 'onDrop'),
});

const trash = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('trash');
const { isOver } = makeDroppable(trash, {
  id: 'trash',
  // Asked when a note is dropped in the trash: the trash is the target.
  onBeforeDrop: () => {
    props.trace('trash', `onBeforeDrop → ${props.answer}`);
    return props.answer;
  },
  onDrop: (event) => {
    props.trace('trash', 'onDrop');
    event.source?.remove();
  },
});

// The library's write, the moment it happens.
watch(notes, () => props.trace('list', 'written'), { flush: 'sync' });
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableList } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import { board, saveMove } from './server';
import TaskCard from './TaskCard.vue';

const props = defineProps<{ id: string; title: string }>();

const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
const { items, isOver } = makeSortableList(list, {
  id: props.id,
  // A getter: the library never writes it. The drop is applied below, once saved.
  items: () => board[props.id]!,
  group: 'sprint',
  // The overlay waits where it was let go until this promise settles.
  onBeforeDrop: async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    try {
      await saveMove(event.keys, event.to);
    } catch {
      // Nothing applied: the card flies back to where it was.
      return 'reject';
    }
    // Applied before the promise resolves: the card lands in its new place.
    for (const [id, tasks] of event.result) board[id] = tasks;
    return 'accept';
  },
});
</script>

import { reactive, ref } from 'vue';
import type { Key } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

export interface Task {
  id: string;
  title: string;
}

/** The store: changed only once the server has agreed. */
export const board = reactive<Record<string, Task[]>>({
  backlog: [
    { id: 'search', title: 'Search in docs' },
    { id: 'avatars', title: 'Upload avatars' },
    { id: 'exports', title: 'Export to CSV' },
  ],
  sprint: [
    { id: 'login', title: 'Passwordless login' },
    { id: 'billing', title: 'Billing page' },
  ],
});

export type ServerMode = 'reliable' | 'flaky' | 'down';
export const mode = ref<ServerMode>('reliable');

/** A request is on its way: the overlay shows it. */
export const saving = ref(false);

interface Request {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  status: 'pending' | 200 | 503;
}
export const requests = ref<Request[]>([]);

let count = 0;
const wait = (ms: number) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

/** A pretend `PATCH`: 0.9 s, and it fails when the server is down, or every other time when flaky. */
export async function saveMove(keys: Key[], to: { list: Key; index: number }): Promise<void> {
  const request = reactive<Request>({ id: ++count, text: `PATCH ${keys.join(',')} → ${to.list}[${to.index}]`, status: 'pending' });
  requests.value = [request, ...requests.value].slice(0, 3);
  saving.value = true;
  try {
    await wait(900);
    const ok = mode.value === 'reliable' || (mode.value === 'flaky' && request.id % 2 === 1);
    request.status = ok ? 200 : 503;
    if (!ok) throw new Error('503 Service Unavailable');
  } finally {
    saving.value = false;
  }
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableList, type DropOutside } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import DockIcon from './DockIcon.vue';

const props = defineProps<{ dropOutside: DropOutside }>();

const APPS = [
  { id: 'mail', name: 'Mail', hue: 210 },
  { id: 'calendar', name: 'Calendar', hue: 350 },
  { id: 'notes', name: 'Notes', hue: 45 },
  { id: 'photos', name: 'Photos', hue: 280 },
  { id: 'weather', name: 'Weather', hue: 190 },
  { id: 'terminal', name: 'Terminal', hue: 220 },
];
const apps = ref([...APPS]);
const notice = ref('Drag an app off the dock and let go');

const dock = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('dock');
const { items } = makeSortableList(dock, {
  items: apps,
  strategy: 'horizontal',
  // What a drop outside every target does. Read at the drop.
  dropOutside: () => props.dropOutside,
  // Called on the list the items leave, with `to.index` -1, when they are removed.
  onDrop: (event) => {
    if (event.to.index === -1) notice.value = `Removed ${event.items.map((app) => app.name).join(', ')}`;
  },
});

const reset = () => {
  apps.value = [...APPS];
  notice.value = 'Dock reset';
};
</script>

<template>

    <ul ref="dock" class="dock">
      <DockIcon v-for="app in items" :key="app.id" :app="app" />
    </ul>
    <p class="notice" role="status">
      {{ notice }}
      <button v-if="apps.length < APPS.length" type="button" @click="reset">Reset</button>
